name: W.W Special

features.text: Leaves a waxy feel on the surface
Thin enough for a pressure-wash system.

description: A shampoo formulated to produce high foam & remove the toughest road film and soil while leaving behind a waxy shine. Works well on cars, trucks, boats, & RVs.
application: DIRECTIONS: FOR BEST RESULTS, SURFACE SHOULD BE COOL AND OUT OF DIRECT SUNLIGHT. 1) Dilute 3 ounces of product with 1 gallon of water. 2) Rinse exterior of vehicle thoroughly. 3) Apply diluted solution generously with a wash mitt, soft cloth, or pressure wash system. 4) Rinse well with clean water. 5) Thoroughly dry vehicle with either a clean chamois or clean, soft towel. As with any car polish, wax or sealant, pre-test on an inconspicuous area prior to applying to entire section.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Foaming - 7 Concentration - 6
